bio.text: Brett Wynkoop is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 52 in Brooklyn in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Wynkoop's campaign website says the candidate graduated from the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy at Kings Point, served as a Naval Reserve officer reaching the rank of lieutenant, and has worked in technology and as a charter sailboat captain and computer science teacher.
Wynkoop was also the Conservative Party candidate for the same Assembly seat in 2024 and for New York City Council District 39 in 2025.
